purchase_request_submission.name: purchase_request_submission
purchase_request_submission.value: ("purchase_requests"."status" = 'submitted') = ("purchase_requests"."submitted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requests"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

scope_matches_unit.name: scope_matches_unit
scope_matches_unit.value: ("role_grants"."scope" = 'tenant' AND "role_grants"."unit_id" IS NULL) OR ("role_grants"."scope" = 'unit' AND "role_grants"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL)

location_requires_unit.name: location_requires_unit
location_requires_unit.value: "role_grants"."location_id" IS NULL OR "role_grants"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL
